It is heavily distorted, appearing melted or stretched horizontally without a clear physical cause (like wind) that would affect only that bubble so drastically while others remain more spherical. This suggests a generation artifact where the spherical constraint failed.

While the iridescence is present, the texture of the colors appears slightly painterly or smudged rather than having the crisp, fluid dynamics of real thin-film interference. However, this is subtle and could be stylistic.

The distortion of the background through the bubbles is somewhat inconsistent with the curvature of the bubbles, particularly the large distorted one. The refraction does not perfectly match the implied lens shape of the bubble film.
